scope: Actual OST GCR proton source, GEO 35786 km / 0 degrees, 2026 launch, five years and the existing explicit 60-month solar timeline. Only H is generated; its incomplete ion-roster warning remains. All source energies and ten retained TENDL products remain in scope. Bounded actual numerical execution, not a full-source accuracy or normative validation.
